features.label: WebRTC web API (RTCPeerConnection)

patches.author: Tom Schuster
patches.subject: Part 2: Block WebRTC connections with Connection Allowlists.

patches.author: serge-sans-paille

features.summary: WebRTC, the technology behind browser video calls, can now use connection allowlists to block connections that are not approved. The other changes are behind-the-scenes updates to the code that supports WebRTC.

features.label: Connection transport (ICE / DTLS)

patches.author: Valentin Gosu
patches.subject: Stop calling nsIURIMutator.setSpec outside necko, and add a lint to prevent new callers.

patches.author: Byron Campen
patches.subject: Plug these leaks a little better.

features.summary: The ICE and DTLS components that help WebRTC find and secure network connections received cleanup and leak fixes. These are _behind-the-scenes reliability improvements_, with no specific change to how connections appear to users.

features.label: Transportbridge

patches.author: Seungmin Kim
patches.subject: Paint I420 frames libwebrtc decodes itself in the color space they declare.

features.summary: Video frames decoded by libwebrtc are now displayed using the color space those frames declare. This helps preserve the intended colors in WebRTC video.

features.label: WebRTC tests

patches.author: Daniel Baker
patches.subject: Don't emit fmtp or rtcp-fb for payload types excluded by setCodecPreferences.

features.summary: WebRTC now leaves out codec-specific settings for codecs a website has excluded using `setCodecPreferences`. This keeps the connection’s advertised audio and video options consistent with the codecs the site actually chose.

features.label: libwebrtc integration

patches.author: Andreas Pehrson
patches.subject: Bug 2081656 (MOZ) - Recreate the send stream instead of reconfiguring it when the MID changes.

features.summary: When a WebRTC media stream’s MID (the identifier that links it to a connection’s media section) changes, Firefox now rebuilds the sending stream instead of trying to reconfigure it in place. This helps the stream handle that change correctly.

features.label: Connection transport (ICE / DTLS)

patches.author: Valentin Gosu
patches.subject: Stop calling nsIURIMutator.setSpec outside necko, and add a lint to prevent new callers.

patches.author: Byron Campen
patches.subject: Plug these leaks a little better.

patches.author: Andreas Pehrson
patches.subject: In TransportLayerDtls search for the single best cipher rather than the full advertised range.

patches.author: Byron Campen
patches.subject: Remove this ancient stund compatibility mode.

patches.author: Byron Campen
patches.subject: Simplify/modernize this, and treat an empty cipher list as an error.

patches.author: John M. Schanck
patches.subject: avoid constructing CERTCertificates for the peer in TransportLayerDtls.

patches.author: Byron Campen
patches.subject: Factor out a version of this function that is designed for use with timers.

patches.author: Andrew Osmond
patches.subject: Don't create candidate pairs from binding responses on an obsolete ICE stream.

patches.author: stransky
patches.subject: Make nr_crypto_nss_hmac() work with FIPS enabled

patches.author: Sylvestre Ledru
patches.subject: Declare every about:license notice in moz.build

features.summary: Firefox tightened and simplified parts of WebRTC’s ICE and DTLS connection setup, including handling outdated network candidates and choosing a suitable encryption cipher. It also improved compatibility with FIPS, a set of cryptographic security standards, and removed an obsolete STUN compatibility mode; most changes are _behind the scenes_.

patches.subject: Don't emit fmtp or rtcp-fb for payload types excluded by setCodecPreferences.

patches.subject: Use the WebIDL spelling of maxPacketLifeTime in the dcsctp interop test.

patches.author: Andrew Osmond
patches.subject: Part 3. Update media test annotations for Android isolated process.

features.summary: WebRTC tests now better cover codec preferences, early media, and data-channel timing, while several tests that had been disabled on particular platforms were re-enabled. The updates help catch problems across desktop and Android without changing the features websites use.

patches.subject: We don't actually need this.

features.summary: Firefox added connection allowlists to WebRTC, the technology behind browser video calls, so connections can be limited to approved destinations. It also improved how Firefox manages WebRTC resources and statistics, including avoiding duplicate stats requests when an earlier reply is still pending; the remaining changes are code cleanup.

features.summary: The Session Description Protocol (SDP), which WebRTC uses to agree on media settings, now handles unfamiliar media types more consistently instead of rejecting them outright. The changes also align how its parsers handle AV1 format parameters, helping different ends of a connection reach the same agreement.

patches.subject: Reject local descriptions whose DTLS fingerprint was modified

features.summary: Firefox’s WebRTC negotiation now rejects a local session description if its DTLS fingerprint—the value used to verify the peer’s secure connection—has been altered. This helps prevent a modified description from being accepted as a trusted connection.

features.label: WebRTC

patches.author: Philipp Hancke
patches.subject: implement webrtc stats targetBitrate and remove totalEncodedBytesTarget

patches.author: Martin Sirringhaus
patches.subject: Make WebRTC work with FIPS enabled

features.summary: WebRTC statistics now report `targetBitrate`, the encoder’s intended video sending rate, and no longer include a redundant encoded-bytes target statistic. Firefox also updated WebRTC cryptography to work when FIPS security requirements are enabled.

features.label: libwebrtc integration

patches.author: Andreas Pehrson
patches.subject: Bug 2081656 (MOZ) - Recreate the send stream instead of reconfiguring it when the MID changes.

patches.subject: Reject malformed planar image picture geometry

features.summary: When a WebRTC media stream’s MID changes, Firefox now rebuilds its sending stream to handle the change more reliably. It also rejects malformed video-frame dimensions instead of processing invalid image geometry.

features.label: Transportbridge

patches.author: Seungmin Kim
patches.subject: Paint I420 frames libwebrtc decodes itself in the color space they declare.

features.summary: Video frames decoded by libwebrtc are now displayed using the color space those frames declare. This helps preserve the intended colors in WebRTC video.

patches.subject: Store desktop capture sources in an nsTArray instead of a map.

features.summary: The video engine’s internal storage for desktop capture sources was changed. This is an implementation detail, with no user-visible behavior change indicated by the patch title.
